title: The z-Transform 489
summary: This page covers 5.1 (The z-Transform 489). OCR text begins with: 5.1 The z-Transform 489 As in the case of the Laplace transform, we need not worry about this integral at this point because inverse z-transforms of many signals of engineering interest can be found in a z-transform table. The direct and inverse z-transforms can be expressed symbolically as X[z] = Z{x[n]} and x[n] = Z −1 {X[z]} or simply as x[n] ⇐⇒ X[z]
